title: UNITED STATES LLC - How the ACT of 1871 changed the US from a REPUBLIC to a CORPORATION!
summary: Promoter video claiming the 1871 District of Columbia act turned the US into a bank-owned corporation, voided later amendments and made birth certificates receipts for assets.

assertions.quote: the act of 1871 that is exactly what changed america from a constitutional republic to a corporation
your birth certificate is a receipt because the bankers own this country and by extension they own us

verdicts.note: No law pledges citizens as collateral; the claim is a core pseudolaw myth rejected by courts and Treasury.

assertions.quote: we got the our congress made a deal with the devil uh in 1871 to incur debt to these bankers

verdicts.note: No 1871 statute or record shows such a pledge; Civil War debt was financed by public bonds.

assertions.quote: according to some sources every constitution after that which is all of these um are northern void

verdicts.note: Later amendments were ratified under Article V and are enforced by every court.

The 16th Amendment was ratified by 40+ states and certified in 1913; courts hold the certification conclusive and reject non-ratification claims, so the income tax amendment is valid (only that amendment is covered).

assertions.quote: any corporation has to be in all caps all right any legal document

verdicts.note: Capitalisation is a typographic convention; courts call the all-caps argument frivolous.

A defendant's claim that he was not the person named because the indictment spelled his name in capitals, a separate 'corporate fiction', was part of the theories the appeal court rejected as baseless.
Duplicate names with one in all capitals, supposedly marking the 'Strawman', are listed as a meaningless pseudolaw motif whose filings the Alberta court refuses.
The Tax Court (Holmes) dismissed as frivolous the claim that IRS letters addressed in all capitals treat the taxpayer as a fictional corporate entity, and imposed a $10,000 penalty.
A claim that the all-caps 'Corporate name' the courts used was an artificial entity failed; the court held the natural person was identified by that name.

assertions.quote: in the original constitution income tax is illegal

verdicts.note: The original Constitution allowed income taxes if apportioned and the Civil War income tax was upheld; the 16th Amendment removed apportionment.

assertions.quote: you're essentially signed away all your rights when you buy a mortgage when you open a bank account

verdicts.note: Mortgages and account agreements are ordinary contracts with defined terms; they grant no general power of attorney.
